content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (walk-away) at § 2.1.**

- **Issue:** § 2.1 binds us to USD 2,000,000 of Services per year for three years on a take-or-pay basis "without reduction or termination rights" — multi-year, no exit, no true-up, failing every fallback element and landing in walk-away territory.
- **Cross-references checked:** § 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges no minimum-volume commitment — directly contradicted by § 2.1), § 7.1 (Order Form fees; bars unidentified minimum-use charges), § 9.5 (no convenience termination right to soften the commitment).
- **Cure:** a single surgical replacement of the § 2.1 commitment sentence with the preferred position — no minimum purchase or volume commitment, payment only for usage or Services ordered under an Order Form. This also removes the internal contradiction with § 12.3, with no collateral rewrites needed. The fallback (12-month term, 30 days' notice reduction, true-up) is offered in the comment.
